page.overview:
Who is Bob?

Bob is a character that is only mentioned in the game Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door.

Bob is only mentioned by his wife Maude in her conversation with Flo in Twilight Town. This conversation can only be heard after Doopliss has been defeated. Being married to Maude who is a crow, it is certain that Bob is a crow as well.
